name: lenny_skills_plus
headline: lenny_skills_plus: Enhance Workflow Automation
short_description: 86 agent-executable skill packs for Claude agents. Converted from RefoundAI’s Lenny skills. Enables automation of operations tasks. Works with Codex + Claude Code.
author: liqiongyu

sections.overview:
The lenny_skills_plus skill is a powerful automation tool designed to streamline workflows by converting 86 agent-executable skill packs from RefoundAI’s Lenny skills into a format compatible with Codex and Claude Code. This skill caters specifically to developers and AI practitioners who are looking to enhance their automation capabilities without extensive overhead. By integrating these skills into your projects, you can leverage the advanced functionalities of AI agents to optimize various tasks and processes. One of the key benefits of using lenny_skills_plus is the significant enhancement it brings to workflow automation. While the exact time savings are currently unknown, the ability to implement this skill in just 30 minutes makes it an attractive option for teams looking to improve efficiency without a steep learning curve. The intermediate complexity of this skill will appeal to those who have some experience with AI automation, allowing them to quickly adapt and integrate it into their existing workflows. This skill is ideal for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who are involved in AI-first projects and seek to automate repetitive tasks. By utilizing lenny_skills_plus, users can focus on higher-level strategic initiatives rather than getting bogged down by mundane tasks. Practical use cases include automating data processing, enhancing customer interactions through AI agents, and streamlining project management workflows. Implementation of lenny_skills_plus requires a basic understanding of AI automation and familiarity with Claude Code. Given its intermediate difficulty level, users should be comfortable navigating AI environments to fully utilize the skill's capabilities. As organizations increasingly adopt AI-first strategies, integrating skills like lenny_skills_plus into your workflow can significantly enhance productivity and drive innovation.

sections.usage:
```
Act as an expert in [INDUSTRY] operations. Use the Lenny Skills Plus package to automate the following task: [TASK]. Provide a step-by-step plan, including any necessary code or commands, to complete this task efficiently. Ensure the solution leverages the capabilities of Claude Code and Codex for optimal automation.
```
